card.name: Words inside legal and warning lists
card.fires_on: Linking words and word starts inside a list of prohibited acts or warning headings. Strongest in the Packers and Stockyards Act phrase 'any course of business or doing any act', and on the start of 'Fetal Toxicity' after a warning list.

modes.label: Prohibited-conduct phrase
modes.description: Words in the legal phrase listing unfair acts or practices that are banned.
modes.example: or engaging in any course of business or doing<< any>> act for the purpose or with the effect

modes.label: Warning heading starts
modes.description: The start of a new heading in a boxed warning or warnings list, such as Fetal Toxicity or an 'and' between two conditions.
modes.example: Discontinue and evaluate clinically (5.10)<< F>>etal Toxicity: Limit use of NSA

card.writes: It leans toward words like matter, matters and conduct, which suggests legal or regulatory subject-matter wording comes next.
card.plain: It fires on wording in rule or warning lists, such as banned business acts or the start of a warning heading.
